protocol.status: Local protocol saved before any noisy MuJoCo trajectory was run; not externally preregistered. Conditions, seeds, gains and noise profiles are copied unchanged from comparison_protocol.json, whose planar outcomes are already known.
protocol.question: In the planar study, exact-load LQR redesign reduced noisy falls from 508 to 334 of 1,620 (186 prevented, 12 introduced). Does that reduction persist when the same conditions, seeds and gains are run on the native wheel-contact MuJoCo plant?
protocol.excluded: The four load-estimate-error variants are not repeated here.
protocol.loads: All nine test loads: 0.35, 0.65, 1.15 kg at 0.14, 0.26, 0.36 m
protocol.profiles: All three noisy profiles (direct_0ms, kalman_0ms, kalman_10ms)
protocol.seeds: 5003 + 104729*i, i = 0..29: identical noise sequences to the planar study and across controllers and engines

engines.purpose: Python port of the archived JavaScript sensing pipeline and RK4 plant; must reproduce the archived outcome of every fixed and exact record before native results are interpreted
Primary native-contact result (same step as the ideal-sensing payload extension)
Complete step-size replicate of the native result

protocol.native_plant: extension_core.LoadedEngine, unchanged: welded payload with matched combined COM and pitch inertia, friction 1, contact time constant 5 ms, start at 0.0452 m, no warm-up. No diagnostic variant from the disagreement study is applied.
protocol.sensing: Measurement = true [x, v, pitch, pitch rate] of the native base; Gaussian noise on pitch and pitch rate only; whole-packet delay; optional two-state Kalman filter (acceleration sigma 50). Same code path for both engines.
protocol.primary: Fall by 10 s (absolute true pitch >= 45 deg at a control endpoint; additionally roll in the native model). Paired transitions fixed -> exact per condition and seed: prevented and introduced falls, per engine.
protocol.persistence_criterion: Declared before execution: the reduction 'persists' if exact has fewer falls than fixed in both native replicates, and prevented falls exceed introduced falls in both. Magnitude is reported, not required to match.
protocol.secondary: Falls by load, scenario and profile; per-seed agreement between engines; survivor outcome labels; peak tilt and squared-torque integral on mutual survivors.
protocol.statistics: Paired counts are descriptive. An exact two-sided sign (McNemar) test on discordant pairs is reported per engine as a summary of seed-level evidence in this known model; the 1,620 pairs share nine loads and two scenarios and are not independent draws from a deployment population.
protocol.step_sensitivity: Noisy closed loops near a fall boundary amplify small numerical differences, so individual seed labels may differ between engines and steps. Aggregate and paired counts are the unit of comparison; per-seed label agreement is reported separately.
protocol.tuning_budget: Zero. No gain, noise, contact or threshold change after seeing results.

source_protocol.status: Prospectively fixed local protocol; not externally preregistered. Test conditions reserved from development, with no performance-based tuning.
source_protocol.design: Continuous-time LQR at upright equilibrium, same Q/R for every assumed payload. Control sampled at 200 Hz and torque saturated. Gains fixed within each run; no online payload estimation.
source_protocol.tuning_budget: Zero performance-based parameter searches. Original Q/R and sensing covariance retained. Development runs check implementation only.
source_protocol.test_seed_formula: 5003 + 104729*i, i=0..29. Same seeds across variants; distinct from prior studies.
source_protocol.force_location: Combined true body COM; the true force moment arm changes with true load, never with its estimated load.
source_protocol.primary: Fall by 10 s at control endpoints, absolute true tilt >=45 deg
source_protocol.secondary: Original final-one-second recovery dwell; final-second RMS tilt/position/speed; torque squared integral and saturation fraction. Full-horizon paired metrics only when both compared trials survive.
source_protocol.statistics: Paired transitions by condition/seed; deterministic totals descriptive. Wilson 95% intervals only per noisy fixed condition. IQR for paired continuous differences. No aggregate deployment probability or unpaired significance tests.
source_protocol.numerical_audit: All 1296 ideal test records repeated with two RK4 substeps preserving 200 Hz control; any changed labels repeated with four.
source_protocol.independent_check: Selected ideal test trajectories checked with independently assembled component mass matrix and SciPy DOP853 under held 200 Hz control. Numerical cross-check, not independent multibody/hardware validation.
